review.summary: The PR introduces three breaking changes to the agents API: (1) the update route method changed from PUT to PATCH without deprecation, (2) the response field `system_prompt` was renamed to `instructions` without a deprecation period, and (3) the `description` field in the create agent body was made required and non-empty. The first two are critical because they silently break existing clients; the third is a warning. No response-schema or semver issues were found (the server is private, so version bumps are not required).

findings.title: CRITICAL - Breaking: Response field `system_prompt` renamed to `instructions` without deprecation
findings.rationale: The response field `system_prompt` was renamed to `instructions` in the `Agent` DTO without a deprecation period. Clients that read `system_prompt` from any agent endpoint will now receive `undefined`. This is a breaking change that should have been done in two steps: first add `instructions` while keeping `system_prompt` (marked deprecated), then remove `system_prompt` in a later major release.

findings.title: WARNING - Breaking: Request body field `description` made required and non-empty
findings.rationale: The `description` field in the `POST /agents` request body was changed from optional (`z.string().optional()`) to required with a minimum length of 1 (`z.string().min(1)`). Clients that previously omitted `description` or sent an empty string will now receive a 422 validation error. This is a breaking change that should be communicated to clients.

findings.title: CRITICAL - Breaking: Route method changed from PUT to PATCH without deprecation
findings.rationale: The route method for updating an agent was changed from PUT to PATCH without any deprecation period. Clients that send PUT requests to `/agents/:id` will now receive a 404 or method-not-allowed error. This is a breaking change that should have been preceded by a deprecation phase where both methods were accepted.
